evals.prompt: Create a custom ProductBadge component that supports sale, new, and discount badge types with appropriate colors and sizes. It should follow the Frontic UI component pattern with CVA variants and data-slot attributes.
evals.expected_output: A CVA-based component with index.ts variant definitions and ProductBadge.vue using the Frontic UI pattern (data-slot, cn(), commerce colors like bg-sale, bg-new, bg-discount)
assertions: Creates index.ts with CVA variant definition
Has variant and size props following Frontic pattern

evals.prompt: Build a product comparison card component that shows two products side by side with their images, names, prices, ratings, and an add-to-cart button for each. Use existing Frontic UI components like Card, Button, and Rating.
evals.expected_output: A composition using Card, CardHeader, CardContent, CardFooter, Button (color=buy), Rating, NuxtImg, and formatPrice utility
assertions: Uses Card sub-components (CardHeader, CardContent, or CardFooter)
Uses Button with color=buy or commerce variant

evals.prompt: Create a product quick-filter bar component that sits above a product grid and lets users filter by color using swatches and by price range using a range slider. Include a reset button.
evals.expected_output: A horizontal bar using SwatchGroup/Swatch for colors and RangeSlider for price, with a Button to reset filters
